description: This file contains functions and classes for generating synthetic time budget data, analyzing time budgets, and handling behavior and observation data within the BORIS behavioral observation software project.

classes.name: StdevFunc
classes.description: Class to enable standard deviation calculation in SQL queries.

methods.name: default_value
methods.description: Returns default value for behavior duration based on behavior type and parameters.

methods.name: init_behav_modif
methods.description: Initializes a nested dictionary with subjects, behaviors, modifiers, and parameters.

methods.name: init_behav_modif_bin
methods.description: Initializes a binary version of behavior modifiers dictionary for subjects.

methods.name: synthetic_time_budget_bin
methods.description: Creates a synthetic time budget divided into time bins, analyzing behaviors within specified intervals.

methods.name: synthetic_time_budget
methods.description: Creates a synthetic overall time budget from observations and behaviors.

methods.name: time_budget_analysis
methods.description: Analyzes time budget data, extracting occurrence counts, durations, and other statistics, optionally grouped by category.
